summary: BCE Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of a voluntary conversion election by holders of its Series AG and Series AH preferred shares. The filing states that 121,070 Series AG shares were tendered for conversion into Series AH, and 1,464,469 Series AH shares were tendered for conversion into Series AG, effective May 1, 2026. No premium, price per share, or special-situation event is present; this is a routine contractual mechanism for preferred share series conversions under the terms of the securities. No board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory review is mentioned. This is a non-event for special-situations analysis, analogous to a routine U.S. issuer filing of a preferred dividend rate reset or conversion notice.
